paragraphs.text: Saturday 9 am to 1 pm in the Town Square. More than 30 stalls selling local produce, with free cooking demonstrations at 11 am. Please bring your own bags, as plastic bags are not provided.
Sunday 10 am in Victoria Park. A 5 km route suitable for all ages. Entry costs £8, including a T-shirt. Online registration closes on Thursday, and there are no entries on the day.
Saturday 8 pm in Castle Gardens. Bring a blanket or a low chair. Tickets cost £6. If it rains, the film will be shown in the Town Hall instead.
Saturday and Sunday, 10 am to 4 pm, at the Central Library. Hundreds of second-hand books from 50p. All the money raised will buy new books for the children’s section.
Sunday 2 pm to 4 pm at the Community Centre. Make your own candle to take home, with all materials included. Suitable for ages 12 and over. Places are limited to 15.

items.quote: If it rains, the film will be shown in the Town Hall instead
items.prompt: moves to a different place if the weather is bad

explanation.en: Only the open-air cinema changes place: “If it rains, the film will be shown in the Town Hall instead” → C.
explanation.kk: Орын тек ашық аспан астындағы кинода өзгереді: «If it rains, the film will be shown in the Town Hall instead» → C.
explanation.ru: Место меняется только у кино под открытым небом: «If it rains, the film will be shown in the Town Hall instead» → C.

items.quote: Saturday and Sunday, 10 am to 4 pm, at the Central Library
items.prompt: takes place on both days of the weekend

explanation.en: “Saturday and Sunday” → D. All the other events are on one day only.
explanation.kk: «Saturday and Sunday» → D. Қалған шаралар тек бір күні өтеді.
explanation.ru: «Saturday and Sunday» → D. Остальные события — только в один из дней.

items.quote: Online registration closes on Thursday, and there are no entries on the day
items.prompt: does not accept people who have not registered in advance

explanation.en: “there are no entries on the day” — you cannot take part without registering first → B. E has limited places but says nothing about registering.
explanation.kk: «there are no entries on the day» — алдын ала тіркелмесеңіз, қатыса алмайсыз → B. E-де орын шектеулі, бірақ тіркелу туралы айтылмаған.
explanation.ru: «there are no entries on the day» — без предварительной регистрации участвовать нельзя → B. В E места ограничены, но про регистрацию не сказано.

items.quote: All the money raised will buy new books for the children’s section
items.prompt: explains how the money collected will be spent

explanation.en: “All the money raised will buy new books for the children’s section” → D. D is used twice — there is an NB. The run in B is for charity, but it does not say how the money is spent.
explanation.kk: «All the money raised will buy new books for the children’s section» → D. D әрпі екінші рет — NB бар. B-дағы жүгіру қайырымдылыққа арналған, бірақ ақша неге жұмсалатыны айтылмаған.
explanation.ru: «All the money raised will buy new books for the children’s section» → D. Буква D второй раз — есть NB. Забег в B благотворительный, но на что пойдут деньги, не сказано.

items.prompt: has a minimum age for participants

explanation.en: “Suitable for ages 12 and over” → E. The run in B is “suitable for all ages”.
explanation.kk: «Suitable for ages 12 and over» → E. B-дағы жүгіру, керісінше, «suitable for all ages».
explanation.ru: «Suitable for ages 12 and over» → E. Забег в B, наоборот, «suitable for all ages».

groups.instruction: Questions 1–5. Look at the five events, A–E. Which event mentions the following? Write the correct letter, A–E. NB You may use any letter more than once.
